task.name: q3-report
task.goal: Create the quarterly forecast report in Acme Portal

automation_synthesis_guidance: This is ground-truth telemetry from one human demonstration of a task on macOS, captured through the accessibility API. You are a TRACE-TO-CODE COMPILER, not a playback bot: your job is to write a standalone, generalized automation script for this task, not to repeat these exact clicks. Clicking the recorded positions on a live app will click the wrong rows, repeat the person's detours, and break the first time a form has a different number of pages. (1) Read `outline` first, then `steps`, and infer the SEMANTIC WORKFLOW: what the person was trying to achieve at each stage, not the literal input sequence. (2) PRUNE. Drop exploratory detours (opening something, finding nothing useful, backing out) and accidental repeats: clicks less than 1000 ms apart on the same element or container where the first produced no `effect`. A step with no `effect` that is immediately undone is noise. (3) GENERALIZE. Treat the strings in `target.element.title`, `target.path` and `container_context` as one instance, not as constants. Match on stable prefixes, roles and accessible names (e.g. a button whose name starts with "Easy Apply"), never on a row index, a pixel position or a full path copied verbatim. Use `parameters` for every value that varies; steps marked `secret` were typed into password fields and never recorded, so your script must prompt for them. (4) WRITE REAL CONTROL FLOW. `container_context.list_item_index` / `total_items` mean the person acted on one row of a list: emit a `for` loop over the rows with a predicate drawn from `item_text_summary`, not a click on that index. Repeated state-advancing clicks (the same "Next"/"Continue" button while `effect.progress` moves 0% -> 20% -> 40%) mean a `while` loop: at each turn read the visible form, fill the required fields, press the advance button, and stop at the terminal action (e.g. "Submit application") or when progress stops changing. `container_context.interactive_siblings` is the form schema of that page, including fields the person never had to touch, so your script can handle pages that ask for more than this run did; `form_same_as_step: N` means that form is unchanged since step N, so read it there. (5) VERIFY, DON'T ASSUME. After each action, check the corresponding `effect` (windows opened/closed/retitled, `dialog_opened`, `toggled`, `progress`) before continuing, and fail loudly rather than guessing. `settle_ms` is roughly how long the app took to respond. (6) `intent` is the person's own explanation of why a step happens; it outranks your inference. The task is done when `success_criteria` holds. Steps marked `optional` did not happen in every run. Locators, in order of robustness: target.element (role + title/description, scoped by target.path and the step's window), then target.ocr_label, then target.rel_xy (fraction of the window), and target.abs_xy only as a last resort.
outline: 1. Click button "New Report" in Safari > Acme Portal - Reports -> opens "Report Wizard"
2. Click text field "Report title" in Safari > Report Wizard
3. Type {report_title} (e.g. "Q3 forecast") into text field "Report title" in Safari > Report Wizard
5. Type {period_end} (e.g. "2026-09-30") into text field "Period end" in Safari > Report Wizard
6. Click password field "Approval PIN" in Safari > Report Wizard
7. Type [secret] into password field "Approval PIN" in Safari > Report Wizard
8. Click button "Create" in Safari > Report Wizard -> closes "Report Wizard" -> window becomes "Acme Portal - Q3 forecast" -> "Share with finance" becomes unchecked
9. Press cmd+s in Safari > Acme Portal - Q3 forecast
